entities.summary: Interfax-Ukraine is a Ukrainian news agency. Founded in 1992, the company publishes in Ukrainian, Russian, English and German. The company presents itself as an independent Ukrainian news agency that serves the country's political and economic news market. It offers over forty news products in four languages. Interfax-Ukraine dispatches have been used by Reuters and Bloomberg in their news coverage from Ukraine.
